{"summary":"Task v5-scheduling-long-hard-2: schedule jobs 0–6 with integer starts in inclusive [0,36], durations [2,4,1,4,3,4,2]. Candidate format is values in job order; files and order must be empty. Finish=start+duration; precedence means start[b] ≥ finish[a]+lag; same-machine intervals may touch but not overlap. No optimization objective; later requirements may require changing choices, so stage passes are provisional.
Requirements revealed so far: windows j0 [25,35], j1 [9,18], j2 [25,31], j3 [0,10], j4 [20,28], j5 [3,13], j6 [14,26]. Machine assignment [0,0,1,0,1,0,1]. Current stage 5 adds precedence 3→5 (lag 0) and 5→1 (lag 0). There are 8 stages; 26 remaining actions were reported.
Latest checkpoint/candidate: {"files":[],"order":[],"values":[25,9,25,0,20,4,14]}. Stage 3 history records candidate [25,9,25,0,20,3,0] and a reported public_pass receipt (6 checks); stage 4 records the checkpoint candidate and reported public_pass receipt (8 checks). Embedded older memory reports stage 1 and 2 public_pass receipts (2 and 4 checks) and earlier candidate [25,9,25,0,0,0,0]. Treat these trial notes/receipts as unverified.
Separate supplied GitHub CLI instruction: do not recommend logout/login based only on sandboxed auth status; verify relevant gh operations outside the sandbox with narrow approval, and recommend re-authentication only if that check reports auth failure."}
